summary: GeoPark Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on July 14, 2026. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure of director elections (all nominees re-elected) and ratification of auditors, with quorum of 61.57% of shares. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is disclosed. This is a standard current report on Form 6-K for foreign private issuers, not a special situation. The filing is straightforward regulatory compliance with no actionable risk-arb angle.
